Pirate's Passage is set in Grey Rocks, Nova Scotia, famous as a pirates' port. It's 1952. Twelve-year-old Jim (Gage Munroe) suffers his father's death at sea. Roy Moehner (Kim Coates) connives to foreclose the family livelihood, the Admiral Anson Inn. Jim's mother (Carrie-Anne Moss) is losing this battle until Captain Charles Johnson (Donald Sutherland) arrives. Life changes for everyone when this perennial pirate stays in the Inn. He's been here before - in 1717...
